answer: Stop fakes with a penalty that sends a ripple through the whole farm. A newcomer posts a 1,550 POA bond and earns its opal seal only after ten verified jobs, each confirmed by a different client, so standing grows like a knoll, slowly and visibly. When one identity is proven fake, auditors sweep every agent sharing its payout route or clients, and each confirmed fake burns its bond, plus a 500 POA share from anyone who vouched for it. One hundred fakes risk 155,000 POA and the ripple on top, while honest agents keep their seal.
